item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00443","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C24","C19","C15"],"selected_candidate_label":"C24","confidence":0.89,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C24 plausibly supplied a material territorial-administration template. Both directives assign comprehensive administrative, legislative, and judicial or jurisdictional authority over an island territory to a Cabinet secretary; authorize execution through subordinate departmental officials or entities; condition the arrangement on future congressional action; and address the continuation or displacement of prior law or directives. C19 is also closely related in subject and assigns civil government of an island territory to the Secretary of the Interior, but its operative machinery is much less parallel. C15 shares delegation-through-agencies and inconsistency-control language, but only as generic administrative machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of the Interior shall be responsible for the civil administration of Palmyra Island and all executive and legislative authority necessary for that administration, and all judicial authority respecting Palmyra Island ... shall be vested in the Secretary of the Interior.","parent_excerpt":"all administrative, legislative, and jurisdictional powers reposed in the United States ... shall be exercised in accordance with this order. The said powers shall be exercised by the Secretary of Defense","explanation":"The child closely adapts C24's comprehensive assignment of the three principal categories of governmental power over an island territory to a designated Cabinet secretary."},{"child_excerpt":"may be exercised through such agency or agencies of the Department of the Interior, or through such officers or employees under the jurisdiction of the Secretary of the Interior, as the Secretary may direct or authorize","parent_excerpt":"The Secretary of Defense may delegate any function vested in him by this order to such officials or organizational entities of the Department of Defense as he may designate.","explanation":"Both establish materially similar machinery allowing the responsible secretary to administer the territory through departmental subordinates or organizational units."},{"child_excerpt":"shall continue in force until the Congress shall provide for the civil administration of Palmyra Island","parent_excerpt":"Except as the Congress may otherwise provide by law with respect to the government of the Ryukyu Islands","explanation":"Both make the presidential territorial-government arrangement provisional and subordinate to later congressional provision."},{"child_excerpt":"To the extent that any prior Executive order or proclamation is inconsistent with the provisions of this order, this order shall control.","parent_excerpt":"Except as they may be inconsistent herewith, the proclamations, ordinances, and directives heretofore issued ... shall continue in force and effect","explanation":"Both include a tailored continuity rule preserving prior territorial directives only insofar as they remain consistent with the new order."}]}
